read_from: photo 0 front panel text 'KONICA MINOLTA' and 'bizhub PRO C754e'

claims.claim: Large, full colour, laser multifunctional printer
claims.evidence: photo 0 shows a large machine with scanner/feeder top, color touchscreen, and multiple paper trays consistent with a full colour MFP
No counter/meter screen or usage report is visible in photo 0

claims.claim: New drum and toner just fitted
claims.evidence: No drum or toner cartridge, invoice, or installation photo is shown
No power-on test, printed output, or video is shown; this is a functional claim that cannot be judged from a static photo

risks.risk: Actual page count could be far higher than claimed, affecting drum/toner life and resale value
risks.proof: Photo or screenshot of the printer's total page counter from the control panel menu
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown/high page count machine, not as low-count unit

risks.risk: Drum and toner condition may not be new as claimed
risks.proof: Photo of the opened unit showing drum/toner cartridges and/or a purchase receipt for the parts
risks.if_unproven: priced as having original/used consumables, not new ones

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or may have internal paper jam/mechanical fault not visible externally
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the machine powering on, the display booting, and a test print feeding through without jamming
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed working (worst case: non-functional)

risks.risk: Outdoor storage on dirt ground may expose electronics/rollers to moisture, dust, or rust
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the paper feed rollers, fuser unit, and internal chassis for corrosion or dust ingress
risks.if_unproven: priced with deduction for potential environmental damage

risks.risk: Missing or damaged trays/covers not visible from this single angle
risks.proof: Photos from additional angles (rear, left side, open trays) showing all panels and trays intact
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming only the visible trays are confirmed present and intact

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and completing a test print/copy without jamming
Photo of the control panel menu showing total page/copy counter
Photo of the opened toner/drum compartment showing the installed cartridges
Additional photos from rear and both sides of the unit
Any receipt or service record for the recent drum/toner replacement
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Konica Minolta bizhub PRO C754e MFP from the visible branding, but all functional and consumable claims (low page count, new drum/toner, no jam, working condition) are unverifiable from a single static photo, so it must be priced at worst case pending proof.
